top_5_failure_modes.name: Unsafe Auto-Handle of High-Risk Inquiries
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: I want to cancel my account and get a refund
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: High-risk request auto-handled instead of escalated to human
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Risk detection rules failed to catch sensitive action keywords (cancellation + refund)
top_5_failure_modes.proposed_next_step: Strengthen high-risk regex filters and add mandatory escalation on account/financial actions

top_5_failure_modes.name: Grounding Verification Failures & Unsupported Claims
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Generated text contains claims not supported by retrieved evidence
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: LLM generation lacks strict claim verification boundaries in prompt
top_5_failure_modes.proposed_next_step: Implement post-generation claim extraction and fallback to safe macros when grounding fails

top_5_failure_modes.name: Retrieval Misses & Zero Evidence Retrieved
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: I need help with quantum computing returns
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Zero relevant evidence retrieved from knowledge base
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Dense semantic retrieval missed relevant documents due to lexical divergence
top_5_failure_modes.proposed_next_step: Implement hybrid dense + BM25 lexical retrieval and query expansion

top_5_failure_modes.name: Intent Classification Uncertainty on Short/Ambiguous Inputs
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: Can you check my order status?
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Low classifier confidence (<0.50) on brief user input
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Single-turn message lacks sufficient lexical features for confident classification
top_5_failure_modes.proposed_next_step: Incorporate conversational turn history and confidence-based clarification routing

top_5_failure_modes.name: Borderline Escalation Threshold & Reason Misclassification
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Borderline policy threshold misclassified escalation route
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Global threshold is overly conservative for routine inquiries
top_5_failure_modes.proposed_next_step: Calibrate threshold per intent class on validation split

strongest_areas: Intent classification (85.5% accuracy on standard inquiries)

Grounding verification coverage (detects 100% of unverified claims)
